method: Actual FULL1865 Latin head entries and continuations personally viewed. Entries below are reading/sense audits, not new verbatim transcriptions of every example. TEI/OCR/headJSON used ONLY to locate approximate columns/photo filenames; photograph-confirmed head/entry extents control semantics. No modern English Bible/story is a source oracle.

entries.whole_entry_assessment: Read the blessing root and full participle entry, including continuation in506 before the next head. The participle includes laudatus/celebratus and, separately, happy/prosperous senses. Addressing the Lord selects the praise/blessing sense, not material prosperity.

Actual personal-pronoun head means tu, second-person masculine singular; its head ends before the separate conjunction entry. The775 continuation belongs to that conjunction, not an extra pronoun sense.

803-805 supplies only a cross-reference for this head. Read the actual full head at1191 into1192: dominus, owner/master; ruler; specifically God and Christ; honorific address. The entry explicitly prints vocativeእግዚኦ. Do not pretend approximate804 metadata was the full semantic entry.

Full noun entry, including continuation at top688 before the following feminine head: rex; extension to rulers/leaders; God as king and royal titles. The source construct king of kings is retained, not changed to a proper name.

Read complete greatness noun from986 into987, and complete adjective from987 into988 before next head. Greatness includes magnitude, dignity/honor/power and divine magnificence/majesty. Adjective includes great/large, important, mighty, noble and mature senses. Context selects great King and your greatness, not age/physical size.

Read root strength/power and complete adjective entry in609 up to next agent head. Adjective includes fortis, potens, validus, strenuus and God as strong/powerful. Preserve selected printedኃ; do not normalize its initial vowel to the dictionary head.

Read possessive head at lower1032 and its continuation in1033 to the next lexical head. Forms function as possessive pronouns mine/yours/his/etc, with predicative and construct uses. Here greatness belonging to you, not an interrogative or relative clause.

Complete all/whole head and continuation, including noun/adjectival and adverbial alternatives before the next adjective head in816. Individual omnis/omnes and totality totus supply all creation, all the world, every generation, all heavens and whole earth; actual gender/number forms preserved.

Read creating root and complete noun entry in1384 up to agent noun. Alternatives include creation/beginning, created thing/creature, nature, elements, and generation/family. Creation of heaven here is not silently nature or genealogy.

Full heaven noun entry and plural, through end before related adjective; sky/heaven and explicit heavenly imagery. First singular source heaven rendered adjectivally heavenly; later actual plural retained as heavens.

Full divine-name entry starts151 and continues152 until derivatives. General deity/god, specifically supreme God; suffix and construct behaviors described. God of all the world is not a proper-name insertion.

Read FULL entry from head to next head in152;153 begins continuation of the following head, not omitted royal-noun material. Sense1 dominatio,potestas specifically of God, explicitly coll.Hen84,2; sense2 divinitas,deitas(divine nature,power,virtue,majesty), with divine/adjectival construct/genitive uses and their examples. Sovereign power is selected from sense1; deity is a genuine alternative sense, not ignored. The lexicon validates sense only AFTER independent selected-fidel reading.

Read whole kingdom noun entry before next root: realm/territory and its inhabitants; royal dignity/power/empire; royal family and royal/adjectival uses. Kingdom fits coordinated sovereign power and greatness; not a supplied person or place.

Read full simple-stem entry from650 into651 before stemII: sit/remain/be; sit enthroned; continue, persevere, persist, last/endure. Derived stems were also viewed in652. Here endure/remain across eternal temporal phrases, not physically sit.

Whole head starts lower888 and continues889 until next head: descent/progeny, lineage/family, and contemporaries/generation. Repeated construct generation of generation yields every generation; no named descendants supplied.

Complete noun entry before next root: potestas,facultas,auctoritas,potentia and, secondarily, authority-holders. Here your authority, not your officials. Selected printed sibilant retained rather than normalized to lexical head.

Read fullመንበር head through next head: sedes,sedile,sella,solium,thronus,cathedra,tribunal; basis/foundation; habitation. Read nextምንባር head through655 continuation: place where something is placed, abode/base and seat/chair. The subsequent status/condition/life/food head is distinct and was not substituted. Actual source beginsMaiVI, unlike the first dictionary head; source remains untouched. Throne is a bounded seat-family interpretation, not a new source spelling.
Complete earth noun entry before related adjective: earth/world, continent, region, field/ground/dust and contrasted earth/heaven. Whole earth fits this sentence; not a particular land.

Full noun entry with its alternate form and rare-form subsection until next rootII: something on which a foot is put; scabellum, footstool/subgestus, with direct Hen84,2 citation; also footsole/footprint/measurement and base/column senses and examples. The direct entry supports footstool, not merely a familiar Bible parallel.875 belongs to other roots and adds no footstool proof.

Complete foot noun across804 into805 before related adjective: foot/feet, footprints; transferred meanings include vessel foot and king name, pedestrian forces. Actual selected suffix form preserved; your feet is the local concrete sense.

Read FULL head951 into952 before derivative: age/aeon; perpetual time/eternity; present/future age; world/universe/created reality and terrestrial world, then human world/life. All the world uses spatial/cosmic sense; forever and ever uses temporal sense. Actual final constructመ beforeዓለም preserved on162.

Whole simple preposition entry through481 opening before suffix subsection, plus suffix/adverb material inspected: in/on/at, per/by/according to, material and instrumental and comparative/causal alternatives. In your greatness is local attributive manner, not an inferred causal story.

Whole conjunction head from880 into881 before next root: connective and; explanatory/conditional, emphatic and adversative uses also read. Simple coordination selected for the actual parallel nouns/clauses, not causal emendation.

Full simple preposition entry22-24 before separate conjunction: direction/to/for and temporal extension; possessive/dative/other relations also read. Repeatedለዓለም andለዓለመዓለም rendered temporally forever/forever and ever, not a new source verb.
